def factor_downside_upasym_adaptive_window(df):
    """Downside volatility asymmetry with volume-regime adaptive rolling window."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()

    is_high_vol, _, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)

    down_sq_20 = (ret.clip(upper=0)).pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum()
    up_sq_20 = (ret.clip(lower=0)).pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum()
    down_count_20 = ret.lt(0).rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum()
    up_count_20 = ret.gt(0).rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum()
    down_vol_20 = (down_sq_20 / down_count_20.replace(0.0, np.nan)).pow(0.5)
    up_vol_20 = (up_sq_20 / up_count_20.replace(0.0, np.nan)).pow(0.5)
    raw_20 = down_vol_20 - up_vol_20

    down_sq_10 = (ret.clip(upper=0)).pow(2).rolling(10, min_periods=5).sum()
    up_sq_10 = (ret.clip(lower=0)).pow(2).rolling(10, min_periods=5).sum()
    down_count_10 = ret.lt(0).rolling(10, min_periods=5).sum()
    up_count_10 = ret.gt(0).rolling(10, min_periods=5).sum()
    down_vol_10 = (down_sq_10 / down_count_10.replace(0.0, np.nan)).pow(0.5)
    up_vol_10 = (up_sq_10 / up_count_10.replace(0.0, np.nan)).pow(0.5)
    raw_10 = down_vol_10 - up_vol_10

    signal = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, raw_10, raw_20)
    df_copy["factor_downside_upasym_adaptive_window"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_downside_upasym_adaptive_window"]

The shorter window enhances responsiveness to rapidly changing risk dynamics, targeting improvement in MI and IC, while the longer window in low-volume regimes preserves the stability and high ICIR/RankICIR of the elite vol_asym_001 lineage. Preserves core downside vs upside volatility asymmetry.
